summary: Iteration 6 – full SEO verification (frontend head/JSON-LD/headings + static SEO files) plus light backend regression. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed (robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /api/sitemap.xml, og-image.jpg, hero webp, /api/products=67, /api/content/home webp heroes, /api/settings, product-by-slug, zelle order zip 32801, admin login + PUT /api/admin/products/<id> with sitemap still valid). Frontend (Playwright, SPA head read after 2s): home, /shop, 3 category/brand pages, product page, /about /contact /brands, and 8 noindex routes all verified. All requested SEO assertions passed: exactly one <title> and one <h1> per page, unique titles/descriptions/canonicals (no duplicates), robots index/follow on public pages and 'noindex, nofollow' on cart/checkout/wishlist/my-account/track/admin/search/404, OG+Twitter tags present, Organization+WebSite site-wide, FAQPage on home, BreadcrumbList on shop/category/brand/static, valid Product JSON-LD (sku/brand/offers price 26.50 USD/InStock/url + aggregateRating when reviews exist), 70/70 images have alt, home-intro/home-delivery-section/home-faq present, FAQ accordion expands, product-specs table visible, breadcrumb nav (aria-label=Breadcrumb) links back to category, 'Browse all' related link present, Add to Cart works (badge 1, item shows on /checkout). No GA/gtag script and no google-site-verification meta (env empty) as expected. Hidden empty categories confirmed absent from header dropdown, footer and home pills (only 7 with-product categories); all 14 nav/category links resolve (no 404).

ui_bugs.issue: React console warning: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' – lowercase attribute in JSX. Only console noise, but should be renamed to fetchPriority (or set via ref) to keep the console clean.

issues: During slide transition the outgoing slide's heading/paragraph text remains visible behind the incoming slide (ghost text overlap, see screenshot). Cosmetic; likely pre-existing crossfade with both slides' text at opacity>0.

action_items: LOW: rename JSX attribute fetchpriority -> fetchPriority in /app/frontend/src/components/HeroSlider.jsx:30 and /app/frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.jsx:95 to remove the React DOM-property warning.
OPTIONAL: hero slider crossfade shows overlapping text of two slides during transition (cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: Seo.jsx is clean: single title/meta/canonical upsert with no duplicate tags across SPA navigations (verified titleTags==1 on 15 routes).
Search-results page canonicalises to https://puff2door.com/shop while being noindex,nofollow – intentional and correct, flagged only so it is not mistaken for a duplicate-canonical bug.

robots.txt served through the preview host is prefixed by Cloudflare-managed content (blanket 'Disallow: /' for AI bots only, plus a second 'User-agent: *' group with 'Allow: /'). The app's own block is intact; on the production domain the duplicate User-agent:* group may be worth consolidating, but nothing blocks search crawlers.
